name: g2-i1current-rf-v1
question: Does a small classifier on current world observation (I1-current) reproduce the past bot's selected_rule better than the preserved lookup baseline? Follow-up comparison, not a blind test (baseline test/shift results were already seen).

target.aux: tactic (mapping below), derived from true and predicted rule; not trained separately

tactic_map.edge: reposition if fight.arena not null else guard (style guard in all 55 runs)

features.target_lookup: target = the snap.chars entry whose ptr == tick.ptr (found for 1475/1475); ptr itself is not an input
features.hostile: snap.chars with team in {6,7,24,25,27,33} and hp>0 (telemetry.Snapshot.hostile teams); horizontal distance hd(c)=hypot(c.x-p.x, c.z-p.z) in m
features.rel_angle: bot convention souls/moves.py rel_angle(a,b) = wrap(atan2(b.x-a.x, b.z-a.z) - (a.heading+pi)) in (-pi,pi]; used by the bot itself for enemies (duel.py:112,1581,1685)
numeric: deg 0..180, how far target is from my facing
min hd over hostile excluding target
hostile excluding target with hd<4 and 3000<=anim<3500

excluded.res: past outcomes — excluded in this I1-current run
excluded.snap.t: capture age — not in the allowed list
excluded.snap.cam_yaw: camera direction — not in the allowed list
excluded.chars.dist: 3D distance duplicate of computed horizontal distances
excluded.map_id,name,npc_param: constant/empty in DSR; npc_param is enemy type — not in the allowed list
excluded.team 0/1/26 chars: not hostile by the bot's own team filter

preprocessing.fit_on: train only (per training set: base and no_dirty variants each build their own dictionaries)
preprocessing.categorical: one-hot over values seen >= 5 times in the training set; other training values -> '__rare__'; values not seen in training -> '__unknown__' (one column each)
preprocessing.numeric_missing: kept as NaN (RandomForest in scikit-learn >= 1.4 handles NaN) plus a 0/1 '<name>__missing' column for every numeric feature that can be NaN (ratios, other_nearest_hd, other_second_hd); no other scaling
preprocessing.check: no feature uses rule, out, res, fight, reflex, care, or anything after the scene

selection.metric: val macro F1 over all classes with >=1 true scene in val
selection.tie: compare rounded to 4 decimals; tie -> smaller max_depth; then candidate order C1..C4
selection.uses: train/val only; test/shift evaluated only after selection.json is written

metrics.macro_f1_baseline_set: baseline A lookup primary_classes for that eval set (read from preserved results.json)
metrics.macro_f1_all_true: all classes with >=1 true scene in that eval set
metrics.per_class: P/R/F1, true n, pred n, runs with that true class; precision 0 if never predicted
metrics.small_class_note: classes with <10 true scenes or <3 runs are reference only
metrics.train_absent: eval classes with 0 train scenes are listed separately
